suspense.title: Suspense
suspense.subtitle: Unapplied receipts waiting to be matched to invoices
suspense.emptyBody: Receipts that cannot be matched automatically appear here.

match.title: Match receipt {number}
match.hint: Pick whole open invoices of the same account; each is settled in full.
match.noneTitle: No open invoices on this account
match.noneBody: There is nothing to match this receipt to yet.
match.over: The selected invoices exceed the unapplied amount

suspense.moveRoleNote: Transferring and refunding to the sender need a billing role

closedNote.REFUND_PENDING: A refund to the sender is waiting for a second approver on the refunds screen.
closedNote.ALLOCATED: This receipt has been applied to invoices.
closedNote.REFUNDED: This receipt was paid back to the sender.

detail.title: Receipt {number}
detail.notFoundBody: It may belong to another legal entity or no longer exist.

suggest.title: Suggested matches
suggest.hint: Ranks the open invoices of the account against this payment. A suggestion only; nothing is allocated.
suggest.noneBody: No open invoice looks like this payment.

transfer.title: Transfer to another account
transfer.hint: Moves the unapplied cash to another active account of the same currency. The item stays open there.
transfer.targetHelp: The ID of the account that should hold the cash
transfer.same: This is the account that already holds the cash
transfer.lookupFailed: The target account could not be loaded
transfer.currencyMismatch: The target account has a different currency
transfer.notActive: The target account is not active
transfer.confirmBody: Receipt {number} moves to account {account}. This posts a ledger move.

refund.title: Refund to sender
refund.hint: Pays the cash back to the sender. A second approver must decide the refund on the refunds screen before it is paid.
refund.payeeHelp: A verified REFUND payee account of the sender; capture one above or paste an existing ID
refund.accountFailed: The account of the receipt could not be loaded
refund.confirmTitle: Refund the receipt to the sender?
refund.confirmBody: A refund for receipt {number} is created and waits for a second approver.
refund.failed: The refund could not be created
refund.approvalNote: A second approver must decide this refund on the refunds screen before the money is paid.

plans.title: Payment plans
plans.subtitle: The plan instance of every attached policy term
plans.emptyBody: Plans appear when a policy term is bound.

mandates.title: SEPA mandates
mandates.subtitle: Direct-debit mandates on record
mandates.scopeNote: Shows mandates imported by the migration; new mandates are not created here yet.

accountCurrents.title: Account-currents
accountCurrents.subtitle: Intermediary statements and disputes
accountCurrents.unavailableBody: Intermediary account-currents are not served by the billing service yet, so there is nothing to show.
